m1.title: Document the milestone agent
m1.note: Demo milestone: no approving review required, so one person can run the whole demo.
m1.rfpText:
# Milestone m1: Document the milestone agent

Write a guide under `docs/` that explains, for a new contributor, how a Nidhi milestone is paid:
how the DAO pre-signs the milestone, how to tag a pull request with the milestone id, what the agent checks,
and where to see the payout. Accept when the guide is merged, CI is green and it lives under `docs/`.

m2.title: Improve the Milestones screen
m2.note: Standard rules: merged, one approving review, CI green. Paid to bob.nidhi-dao.eth on Arbitrum Sepolia.
m2.rfpText:
# Milestone m2: Improve the Milestones screen

Improve the app's Milestones screen (`ui/src/`): clearer status for each milestone, or a better empty state.
Accept when the change is merged with one approving review and CI is green.
